This is the 13th chapter of the [[Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!]] manga. It was first published in the August 2023 issue of ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'', released on June 21, 2023.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20240205062714/https://www.bookshop-ps.com/bsp/bsp_magcode?sha=1&sho=1385908123 ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' August 2023 issue | Shogakukan BOOK SHOP] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20230621052146/https://corocoro.jp/news/366186/ ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' August 2023 issue | CoroCoro Comics] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kemonmon/status/1671833846013399041 Kemon Kawamoto on X (Twitter)] (Japanese)</ref> It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on November 27, 2023.
